title: Right at home in Nashville
description:
All the comforts of home in the heart of nashvile:
spacious luxury 2 story home in super location, perfect for singles,couples or family vacations/reunions. Two miles from airport,quick ride to opryland/grand ole opry (6 miles) short drive to broadway honky-tonks and downtown music city landmarks (9 miles),2 miles to nashville shores 385 acre water park,stones throw to elm hill marina lake and recreation area percy priest lake.Great eats and drinks nearby Darfons,McNamara's and other great spots

Guest access
entire space except for the garage and a few locked closets

Other things to note
local government of nashville mandated anyone with a short term rental permit  to collect a .06 percent hotel occupancy priviledge tax,you can pay it upfront during check in or thru the airbnb  resolution center.   thanks  so much  john v.
